meta.title: Request a Product | AWS OVERSEAS impex
meta.description: Can't find what you're sourcing in our catalog? Tell us the product you need — name, a short description, a photo, and how much you need — and our sourcing team will get back to you.

hero.title: Looking for something we don't list yet?
hero.subtitle: Tell us what you need — a name and a way to reach you is enough. A description, a photo, and quantity all help, but none of it is required.
hero.note: No account needed — anyone can send one.

product.title: The product
product.description: Name it, then tell us anything that pins it down — specs, materials, how much you need. A photo helps most of all.

contact.title: How we reach you
contact.description: We answer by email or phone, so leave us at least one of them.
contact.prefillNote: Filled in from your account — change anything you'd rather we used instead.

message.label: Description or message
message.placeholder: Specs, materials, intended use — anything that helps us source the right thing

submit.title: Send it over
submit.description: Our sourcing desk reads every enquiry. If we can move it, you'll hear back with availability and a price — pricing is never published online.
submit.privacyText: Your details are used to answer this enquiry and nothing else.

form.successMessage: Thanks — we've got it. Our sourcing desk will come back to you by email or phone shortly.
